summary: FFLA lists a platform tower called Bear Mountain in St. Lawrence County as gone; a trail guide describes a wooded summit and a Cranberry Lake overlook, with no tower. The list's point has not been matched to that peak.

facts.status_note: Listed by FFLA as gone. No source describes a tower standing on the mountain today; one guide mentions an open bedrock platform at the summit.

access.note: Part of the public Forest Preserve; reached on foot by trail.

visit.trail_note: Shorter route to the Cranberry Lake overlook starts at the Cranberry Lake campground, which charges a day-use fee.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only source tying a lookout to this name is the FFLA list entry (type Platform Tower, status Gone, no build, staffing or removal dates). Trail guides name a 'Bear Mountain Lookout' on a trail sign and for a viewpoint, but none of the pages read describes a tower or platform, so nothing ties the FFLA entry to that spot. The FFLA point (44.19522, -74.81273) was not checked against a map; a search result (trailsnh.com, not read) gave a point about 600 m away at 44.1899, -74.8141. Story is short because the evidence is short; a human could check the NYS DEC and Forest Preserve records for a tower on this mountain. Search budget used on this tower: three queries, which is over the limit.
